source: Week2 汇报.pdf + A.pdf — 孙海崴 A股价量因子

factors.name_zh: 量能分位 × 应激动量
factors.formula: clip(ema(ts_delta(close, 1) / delay(close, 1) * ts_rank(volume, 6) * (high - low), 12), -2.5, 2.5)
factors.note: 日收益 × 6日量能分位 × 日内振幅；EMA(12)+clip(±2.5)

factors.formula: clip(ema((close / delay(close, 5) - 1) * ts_rank(volume, 8) * (high - low), 12), -3, 3)
factors.note: 5日动量 × 8日量能分位 × 应激区间

factors.formula: ema(ts_delta(close, 1) * log(1 + volume / ts_mean(volume, 5)) * (1 + min(2, max(0, (high - low - ts_mean(high - low, 5)) / ts_std(high - low, 5)))), 12)
factors.note: ΔC（绝对涨跌额）× log量比 × 5日range z-score 加成

factors.formula: (high - low) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)
factors.note: 日内波动 × 相对20日均量

factors.formula: ema(ts_delta(close, 1) / delay(close, 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20) * (1 + min(2, max(0, (high - low - ts_mean(high - low, 10)) / ts_std(high - low, 10)))), 10)
factors.note: 收益×量比×10日range z-score

factors.formula: ema(ts_delta(close, 1) * log(1 + volume / ts_mean(volume, 5)) * (1 + min(2, max(0, (high - low - ts_mean(high - low, 10)) / ts_std(high - low, 10)))), 12)
factors.note: ΔC（绝对涨跌额）× log量比；zscore 窗口 10 日

factors.formula: ema(if_else((high - low) > median(high - low, 20), close / open - 1, 0) * ts_max(volume, 20) / volume, 20)
factors.note: 日内方向 × 极端放量 × range 高于20日中位数才生效

factors.formula: tanh(2 * (high - low) / (2 * close - high - low) * ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_mean(high - low, 5))
factors.note: 日内反转位置 + tanh 压缩

factors.formula: ema((close / open - 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20), 10)
factors.note: 日内涨跌方向 × 相对20日均量

factors.formula: ts_mean((high - low) / (2 * close - high - low) * ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_mean(high - low, 5), 3)
factors.note: 日内反转核 × 3日平滑

factors.name_zh: 应激 dir clip 2.5 变体
factors.formula: ema(max(0, (high - low - ts_mean(high - low, 40)) / ts_std(high - low, 40)) * min(2, volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)) * clip((high - low) / (close - open), -2.5, 2.5), 15)
factors.note: 应激累积 × 量比 × 方向 clip ±2.5

factors.name_zh: 应激 dir w25 变体
factors.formula: ema(max(0, (high - low - ts_mean(high - low, 40)) / ts_std(high - low, 40)) * min(2, volume / ts_mean(volume, 25)) * clip((high - low) / (close - open), -2, 2), 15)
factors.note: 量比基线 25 日，方向 clip ±2

factors.formula: ema(close / (high - low), 10) * ema(volume / ts_mean(volume, 25), 15) * ema(close / (close - open), 3)
factors.note: 波动 × 量能 × 方向 三因子乘积

factors.name_zh: 自适应 sigmoid 量能混合
factors.formula: ema(close / (high - low), 8) * (sigmoid(5 * (volume - 0.85 * ts_mean(volume, 25))) * ema(volume, 10) + (1 - sigmoid(5 * (volume - 0.85 * ts_mean(volume, 25)))) * ema(volume, 30))
factors.note: sigmoid 切换快/慢 EMA 量能混合

factors.formula: (close / delay(close, 5) - 1) * (1.5 - 0.5 * ts_rank(ts_std(ts_delta(close, 1), 20), 20))
factors.note: 5日动量 × 逆波动权重

factors.formula: ema(ts_delta(close, 1) / delay(close, 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20), 5)
factors.note: 价量一致性核心因子

factors.formula: ema((divide(close - low, high - low) - 0.5) * divide(median(high - low, 20), high - low), 5)
factors.note: 区间位置 × median(range)/range 连续波动缩放

factors.formula: ema((close / delay(close, 5) - 1) * ts_max(volume, 20) / volume * (divide(median(high - low, 20), high - low) - 1), 5)
factors.note: 短动量 × 极端放量 × 波动率偏离

factors.name_zh: 应激累积 × 量权 × 方向
factors.formula: ema(max(0, (high - low - ts_mean(high - low, 40)) / ts_std(high - low, 40)) * min(2, volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)) * clip((high - low) / (close - open), -3, 3), 15)
factors.note: 应激累积 × 量比 × 方向 clip ±3

factors.formula: ema(close / (close - open) * median(volume, 10) / volume, 5)
factors.note: 代数化简：(H-L)/(C-O)*C/(H-L)=C/(C-O)；量能中位比

factors.formula: ema((high - low) / (close - open) * median(volume, 10) / volume, 5)
factors.note: 去掉 stress range 的 ablation

factors.name_zh: 上涨/下跌不对称 range 比
factors.formula: -1 * ema(divide(divide(ts_sum(if_else(close <= open, high - low, 0), 20), ts_sum(if_else(close <= open, 1, 0), 20)), divide(ts_sum(if_else(close > open, high - low, 0), 20), ts_sum(if_else(close > open, 1, 0), 20))) * median(volume, 10) / volume, 2)
factors.note: 涨跌日条件均值比（汇报为条件 median，DSL 用 masked mean 近似）

factors.name_zh: 订单失衡 × 量比 EWM
factors.formula: ema((high - low) / (close - (high + low) / 2) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20), 5)
factors.note: 收盘相对区间中点失衡 × 量比

factors.name_zh: 自适应波动率门控动量 v2
factors.formula: divide(close / delay(close, 5) - 1, ts_std(ts_delta(close, 1), 30))
factors.note: 5日动量 / 30日波动率

factors.formula: (close / delay(close, 5) - 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20) * sign(close - (high + low) / 2)
factors.note: 量确认动量 × 相对区间中点方向

factors.formula: ema(divide(close - low, high - low) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20), 5)
factors.note: 区间位置 × 量比，EMA(5)

factors.formula: -1 * ema(divide(divide(ts_sum(if_else(close <= open, high - low, 0), 15), ts_sum(if_else(close <= open, 1, 0), 15)), divide(ts_sum(if_else(close > open, high - low, 0), 15), ts_sum(if_else(close > open, 1, 0), 15))) * median(volume, 10) / volume, 2)
factors.note: 条件均值比，窗口 15

factors.formula: -1 * ema(divide(divide(ts_sum(if_else(close <= open, high - low, 0), 20), ts_sum(if_else(close <= open, 1, 0), 20)), divide(ts_sum(if_else(close > open, high - low, 0), 20), ts_sum(if_else(close > open, 1, 0), 20))) * ema(volume, 5) / volume, 2)
factors.note: 条件均值比 + 量比基线 ema(volume,5)

factors.formula: ema((close / open - 1) * volume / ts_max(volume, 20), 20)
factors.note: 日内方向 × V/max(V,20)；EMA(20)

factors.formula: ema(ts_delta(close, 1) / delay(close, 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 5) * (high - low) / close, 5)
factors.note: ΔC/C × V/MA(V,5) × (H-L)/C；EMA(5)

factors.name_zh: 方向性波动×量能(25日基准)
factors.formula: ema(close / (high - low), 10) * ema(volume / ts_mean(volume, 25), 15) * ema((close - open) / close, 3)
factors.note: C/(H-L) × V/MA(V,25) × (C-O)/C 三分量独立 EMA

factors.formula: ema((close / delay(close, 5) - 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20), 10)
factors.note: 5日动量 × 量比；EWM(10)（汇报未展开公式，按逻辑簇还原）

factors.formula: -1 * (2 * close - high - low) / (high - low) * ts_mean(high - low, 5) / ts_mean(close, 5)
factors.note: Williams 型收盘位置 × MA(H-L,5)/MA(C,5)

factors.formula: ema((close / delay(close, 3) - 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20), 5)
factors.note: 3日短周期动量 × 量比；EMA(5)（汇报未展开公式，按逻辑簇还原）

factors.formula: ema(close / (high - low), 8) * ema((close - open) / close, 10) * ema(volume / ts_mean(volume, 25), 15)
factors.note: 波动×方向×自适应量能三分量交叉（汇报未展开公式，按逻辑簇还原）

factors.formula: (close / delay(close, 5) - 1) * (0.5 + 0.5 * ts_rank(ts_atr(high, low, close, 14) / close, 20)) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)
factors.note: Ret5 × [0.5+0.5×RankPct(ATR14/C)] × V/MA(V,20)

factors.formula: (close / delay(close, 5) - 1) * volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)
factors.note: 经典 5日量确认动量（无额外平滑）
